title: wedelia jacquinii subsp. calycina
intro: Wedelia jacquinii subsp. calycina, commonly known as Wedelia, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce nausea, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against various pathogens. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia jacquinii subsp. calycina include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
